asset_heavy.reason: Electrical contracting and custom equipment fabrication are project-based and labor-driven; they need moderate plants but not heavy networks or fleets.

big_ticket.reason: Electrical installations for data centers, housing and industrial facilities, plus custom switchgear and structural projects, are large one-off project sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: New construction in data centers, housing and commercial or industrial facilities can be postponed or cut in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are data center developers, industrial and commercial builders and large projects like Apple Park and JFK terminal.

notes: Residential segment sells installation to homebuilders, so mainly organizational buyers. Communications and infrastructure solutions are smaller segments.

offers_products.reason: Custom Power Solutions makes generator enclosures, switchgear and bus systems; infrastructure products are named among its offerings.

offers_services.reason: Designs and installs electrical and technology systems for commercial, industrial and residential projects, with maintenance and field services.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from installed systems, materials and manufactured equipment as well as labor; it is a contractor and manufacturer.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue comes from construction projects and custom equipment orders, not subscriptions or repeat consumables.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Residential work is sold to homebuilders and developers, not households; main buyers are businesses.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers include data center owners, commercial and industrial facility owners, homebuilders, general contractors and infrastructure operators.
